segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, thanks for making the time, Dana. Last we talked, you were looking at calibration tracking for the two Ohio plants, about 210 instruments total. Is that still the right scope?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Pretty close. We counted again and it’s 236 active gauges, plus maybe 12 that are spares. Users would be 14 technicians and 5 supervisors, so 19 seats to start.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Okay, 19 named seats and up to 250 assets fits the standard team plan. That’s $18,600 annually, billed upfront, and implementation is a one-time $3,200. No charge for the spare gauges unless you want them on active schedules.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: That works. Procurement will ask about payment terms. We usually do net 45, not net 30.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, net 45 is fine for companies your size. I’ll put that on the order form. The subscription would start February 1, with a target go-live of March 4 if we get the asset export by February 9.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: March 4 is good. We have an audit the week of March 18, so I don’t want to be learning the system that week.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Understood. The implementation schedule would be import on February 12, admin training February 20, technician training February 27, then a check-in after the first week live. Pretty standard.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Can the invoice split the subscription and implementation as two lines? Same PO, just separate lines for accounting.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yes, no problem. One annual invoice, two line items: software subscription $18,600 and implementation $3,200, net 45. Total $21,800 before applicable tax.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay. Send that over today and I’ll route it. If legal doesn’t change anything, I think we can sign by next Friday, January 19.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Sounds good. I’ll send the order form and the service terms after this call. Once it’s signed, we’ll schedule the kickoff for the week of February 5.
